300:t_1:4.en:
$$小野Ｄ$$
「...So the closing ceremony's canceled after all.」

300:t_1:5.en:
$$風間$$
「It sounds like the school will explain what happened yesterday.」

300:t_1:6.en:
$$小野Ｄ$$
「How is $$常磐$$? I heard she was badly hurt in yesterday's chaos...」

300:t_1:7.en:
$$詩織$$
「She's still in the hospital. They say she's out of danger for now.」

300:t_1:8.en:
$$小野Ｄ$$
「...Where's everyone from the volunteer club?」

300:t_1:13.en:
$$詩織$$
「Where's $$かなめ$$!? Is she with you, $$相良$$!?」

300:t_1:17.en:
$$宗介$$
「Yesterday, the one piloting that white AS... was me.」

300:t_1:19.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'm a soldier from a mercenary unit. I'm now in a special unit of the $$地球連邦軍$$.」

300:t_1:20.en:
$$宗介$$
「I came to this school to protect $$千鳥かなめ$$ from an organization hostile to the one I belonged to.」

300:t_1:21.en:
$$風間$$
「What about $$兜$$ and the others!? Was everyone in the volunteer club a mercenary!?」

300:t_1:24.en:
$$宗介$$
「But it was my fault the school got caught up in yesterday's battle.」

300:t_1:25.en:
$$宗介$$
「...$$千鳥$$ was... taken away, too...」

300:t_1:26.en:
$$小野Ｄ$$
「...You... could you say that to $$常磐$$'s face...?」

300:t_1:28.en:
$$小野Ｄ$$
「Don't give me that shit! $$常磐$$'s still in the hospital! What the hell did you come waltzing in here for!?」

300:t_1:30.en:
$$小野Ｄ$$
「You shut up, $$風間$$! This bastard...!」

300:t_1:32.en:
$$宗介$$
「I just wanted to tell you one thing...」

300:t_1:34.en:
$$宗介$$
「I will bring $$千鳥$$ back. I promise.」

300:t_2:5.en:
$$スズネ$$
「...It's already been a week since we came here...」

300:t_2:6.en:
$n
「I've managed to finish the emergency repairs on $$ジェニオン$$. We can leave tomorrow.」

300:t_2:7.en:
$$スズネ$$
「You say we're leaving... but where are we going?」

300:t_2:9.en:
$$スズネ$$
「None of the communications I intercepted today gave me any leads.」

300:t_2:10.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Everyone besides us, in that $$時空震動$$...」

300:t_2:11.en:
$n
「It'll be all right, Miss $$スズネ$$. Wherever they were sent, I'm sure they're safe.」

300:t_2:12.en:
$n
「And they must be looking for us, too. $$ＡＧ$$ would never abandon that precious $$ジェニオン$$.」

300:t_2:14.en:
$n
「Until we know what's happening, we'll stay nearby and use this island as a base camp. There's fresh water here, and plenty of plants and animals.」

300:t_2:15.en:
$$スズネ$$
「...You seem so full of life. Is it because you can use your $$ビーストハンター$$ experience?」

300:t_2:16.en:
$n
「Doing everything we can to survive is both the duty and the right of every living thing.」

300:t_2:17.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Is that something your dad said?」

300:t_2:24.en:
$n
「I was... wondering whether $$宗介$$ is safe...」

300:t_2:26.en:
$n
「I wasn't just thinking about $$宗介$$... I was thinking about everyone in $c... and this world.」

300:t_2:27.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Even though we don't know what'll happen to us...?」

300:t_2:28.en:
$n
「I can do something about my own situation if I take action.」

300:t_2:29.en:
$n
「But when it comes to other people... all I can do is wait...」

300:t_2:30.en:
$$スズネ$$
「You're optimistic even in a situation like this...」

300:t_2:31.en:
$n
「You and everyone else taught me to be that way, Miss $$スズネ$$.」

300:t_2:33.en:
$n
「Everyone gets down sometimes. So right now, I'll protect you.」

300:t_2:34.en:
$$スズネ$$
「...You've been protecting me ever since we first got into $$ジェニオン$$, $n.」

300:t_2:35.en:
$n
「That's not true. I'm the one who's been protected.」

300:t_2:36.en:
$$スズネ$$
「We protect each other... I think that's what being partners means...」

300:t_2:37.en:
$$スズネ$$
「In my case, there's my responsibility as a teacher on top of that.」

300:t_2:38.en:
$n
「But your special teaching practicum is over now, isn't it? The closing ceremony was last week.」

300:t_2:39.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Then will you call me $$スズネ$$ from now on?」

300:t_2:41.en:
$$スズネ$$
「...If we don't find the others, shall we stay here together and become this island's Adam and Eve?」

300:t_2:44.en:
$n
「That's not it, but I'm not ready for...!」

300:t_2:47.en:
$$スズネ$$
「...I'm kidding. Do you feel a little better?」
